tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Ink in dark, cream in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and panels on bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and anything above a surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders. 3.2:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. 14:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders. 6.3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Links, focus rings, selected states and the word Reka. 4.5:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: primary-fill
tokens.usage: Small violet marks such as the progress bar, and the violet app icon ground, in both themes. Never a button fill: the primary button is ink-950 with a primary rim. Pair with on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on an interactive primary-fill mark. Lighter on dark, darker on light. on-primary on it: 5.1:1 dark, 8.0:1 light.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chips and the input focus halo. primary text on it: 4.9:1 dark, 6.5:1 light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber, the cat's eyes. Highlights, streaks and rewards. Fill only; text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Amber used as text. 4.9:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status only: done, saved, on track. Always with an icon and a label.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status only: needs attention. Always with an icon and a label.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Status only: failed, invalid. Always with an icon and a label.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First categorical series. Assign series in this fixed order, never cycled.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical series. Scatter plots and maps stop here.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth categorical series. A sixth series folds into chart-other.

tokens.name: chart-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, lowest magnitude. Violet only; status colors never encode magnitude.

tokens.name: chart-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 5. Highest step in dark mode.

tokens.name: chart-seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, highest step in light mode. Dark mode uses five steps; this repeats step 5 there.

tokens.name: violet-50
tokens.usage: Violet scale. Tints for selected rows in light mode.

tokens.name: violet-400
tokens.usage: Violet scale. The cat's rim and Reka on dark.

tokens.name: violet-500
tokens.usage: Violet scale. The cat's inner ears and brows.

tokens.name: violet-600
tokens.usage: Violet scale. Brand violet: Reka on light, the book, the violet icon.

tokens.name: violet-950
tokens.usage: Violet scale. Tints for selected rows in dark mode.

tokens.name: amber-700
tokens.usage: Amber scale. Amber text on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink-950
tokens.usage: Neutral. Brand ink: the cat, dark background.

tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: Neutral. Brand cream: light background, Arandu on dark.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One hero line per screen, at most. 36/42 on screens 768px and wider.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles. 24/30 on screens 768px and wider.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Arandu's chat messages and lead paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Me conta: o que você faz quando ninguém está te pedindo nada?
styles.usage: Default text. Text typed into inputs is 16px on phones, so iOS Safari does not zoom in on focus.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: É uma estimativa, não uma sentença.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chips, chart axes, timestamps. Never for sentences.

spacing.note: A 4px base, kept tight. Proposed for v1; the app has no spacing scale yet.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a group: chips in a row, stacked lines, button side padding in compact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding, card padding on phones, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side margins on phones, card padding on wider screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margins on screens 768px and wider, large section breaks.
